title: Volume
goal: Learn why the count of shares traded matters.

objectives.text: Say what the volume bars show.
Tell a tall bar from a short bar.
Know why volume matters in a big move.
Know that volume does not predict.

slides.text: Volume is how many shares were traded. It shows as bars at the bottom. Each bar matches one candle.
slides.title: Bars under the candles

demo.caption: Real Apple history. The bars below show volume.

slides.text: A tall bar means many shares traded. A short bar means few shares traded.
slides.title: Tall and short

slides.text: A big move on high volume has a big crowd. A big move on low volume has a small one.
slides.title: What it tries to tell you

slides.text: High volume does not tell you the next move. It shows how busy it was. Do not trust it alone.
slides.title: Not a promise

questions.prompt: What do the volume bars show?
questions.explanation: Each bar shows the shares traded.

questions.prompt: A tall volume bar means many shares traded.
questions.explanation: Yes. Tall means busy. Short means quiet.

questions.prompt: A big move comes with high volume. What does it mean?
questions.explanation: High volume means a lot of shares traded in the move.

questions.prompt: Find the candle with the most volume. Tap it.
questions.explanation: The tall bar is the busy one.

questions.prompt: High volume tells you which way the price will go next.
questions.explanation: No. Volume shows how busy it was.

questions.prompt: Where do the volume bars sit?
questions.explanation: Volume bars sit at the bottom.

questions.prompt: Turn on Volume. Keep the rest off.
questions.explanation: Volume bars show at the bottom.
